forWhat: Make an assessment, read one that came back, and follow each one from made to results in.
Each assessment is one row. The row's button is always the next thing to do.

layout.shows: Four tiles: [[For a class]], [[For each child]], [[For one child]] and [[A ready-made worksheet]].
A box to drop scans or photos, and a field for a Google Drive link with the button [[Read it]].
Class, Topic, Subject, Kind, Week and Stage, and a search box.
One row per assessment. Its steps run from [[Created]] to [[Results in]], then the score and the next button.
Files read lately and what each one lacks, and a short note on how it works.

jobs.title: Make an assessment for a class
steps: Press [[Make an assessment]], or the tile [[For a class]].
Choose the class, what it is, how it is made, and the children.
Press [[See the papers]]. Every child's paper shows on screen before anything is made.
Not happy with a child's questions? Press [[Different questions]]. It draws others and makes nothing.
Press [[Make and approve …]]. The papers are made exactly as you saw them, in your name.

jobs.title: Follow an assessment
steps: Find its row. The filter row and search help when the list is long.
Press the row's next button: [[Approve]], [[Print]], [[Upload]], [[Check]] or [[See results]].
Press the assessment's name to see each child's copy and where it stands.

jobs.title: Rename an assessment
steps: Press [[Rename]] on its row, type the new name and press [[Save]].
The old names are kept. An empty name changes nothing.

buttons.label: Make an assessment
buttons.does: Opens the page that makes papers.

buttons.label: Different questions
buttons.does: Draws other questions for you to look at.

buttons.label: Make and approve …
buttons.does: Makes the papers you saw and approves them in your name.
buttons.doesNot: If you change a choice, it waits until you see the papers again. Pressing it twice makes the papers once.

buttons.label: Approve
buttons.does: On a home assessment's row, approves that one row and marks its papers printed.

buttons.label: Read it
buttons.does: Reads the scan at a Google Drive link.
buttons.doesNot: It takes only Google Drive links.

buttons.label: Rename
buttons.does: Gives the assessment a new name.
buttons.doesNot: The older names are kept, not deleted.
